summary: Los Angeles County lookout built 1934 by Angeles NF; 1959 newspaper account says it was evacuated during a fire; 2012 blog says removed; 2022 trip report notes towers on the point.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 10 ft open timber tower
facts.status_note: Register gives the removal date as unknown; a 2012 blog says the lookout was completely removed; a 2022 trip report describes towers on the point

access.note: 2012 and 2022 trip reports describe hikers walking a fire road to the tower point; no official access notice was read

visit.trail_note: Walk an unshaded fire road to the lookout point and the point with towers, per a 2022 trip report

facts.agency: US Forest Service, Angeles National Forest

events.note: Constructed by the Angeles National Forest
Officials said, in an Arizona Republic report of October 19, 1959 quoted on Forest Lookouts, that a lookout at the Whitaker Peak station saw a man set a fire
Third blaze on Whitaker Peak charred about 100 acres and forced evacuation of the lookout tower
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on November 3, 2019

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and the blog spell Whitaker; the Forest Lookouts page and a caption on the register page spell Whittaker. The record keeps Whitaker.

Register does not know when the tower was removed. A 2012 blog says the lookout was completely removed. A 2022 trip report mentions a point with towers, which may or may not be the lookout site; the story does not say what the towers are.

notes_for_editor: The 1959 account is quoted second-hand from The Arizona Republic on the Forest Lookouts page; the original article was not read. Today's condition rests on a 2012 blog and a 2022 trip report, both personal accounts. The AllTrails page returned HTTP 403 and was not used; its search snippet mentions radio towers, but that is unverified, so the story says only towers. The access level comes from trip reports and a gate, not an official notice, so check before publishing a firm access claim. The register spells the peak Whitaker; the Forest Lookouts page spells it Whittaker.
